an4.160:1.1: Sugato vā bhikkhave loke tiṭṭhamāno sugatavinayo vā tad assā bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an4.160:2.2: Idha bhikkhave Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā.
an4.160:3.2: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an4.160:3.4: Sugato vā bhikkhave loke tiṭṭhamāno sugatavinayo vā tad assa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. 3.
an4.160:4.1: Cattāro 'me bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an4.160:4.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhū duggahītaṃ suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇanti dunnikkhittehi padavyañjanehi.
an4.160:4.4: Dunnikkhittassa bhikkhave padavyañjanassa attho pi dunnayo hoti.
an4.160:4.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati. 4.
an4.160:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū dubbacā honti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā akkhamā appadakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaniṃ.
an4.160:5.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati. 5.
an4.160:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā te na sakkaccaṃ suttantaṃ paraṃ vācenti,
an4.160:6.2: tesaṃ accayena chinnamūlako suttanto hoti appaṭisaraṇo.
an4.160:6.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati. 6.
an4.160:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave therā bhikkhū bāhulikā honti sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā na viriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā aṇadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya,
an4.160:7.3: sā pi hoti bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā na viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an4.160:7.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati.
an4.160:7.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro dhammā saddhammassa antaradhānāya saṃvattantīti. 7.
an4.160:8.1: Cattāro 'me bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an4.160:8.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhū suggahītaṃ suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇanti sunikkhittehi padavyañjanehi.
an4.160:8.4: Sunikkhittassa bhikkhave padavyañjanassa attho pi sunnayo hoti.
an4.160:8.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati. 8.
an4.160:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū subbacā honti sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā khamā padakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaniṃ.
an4.160:9.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiya asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati. 9.
an4.160:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā te sakkaccaṃ suttantaṃ paraṃ vācenti,
an4.160:10.2: tesaṃ accayena na ca chinnamūlako suttanto hoti sappaṭisaraṇo.
an4.160:10.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati. 10.
an4.160:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave therā bhikkhū na bāhulikā honti na sāthalikā okkamaṇe pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā viriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya,
an4.160:11.3: Sā pi hoti na bāhulikā na sāthalikā okkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an4.160:11.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati.
an4.160:11.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantīti. [Tass' uddānaṃ:
